description:
Diable Avionics Skin - LUXURIOUS BRONZE
Luxurious Bronze, a comprehensive skin pack for the Diable Avionics faction.


Download:
Patreon

Requires Diable Avionics by Tartiflette and FlashFrozen
Support Tartiflette here: https://www.patreon.com/tartiflette


Custom paintjobs for the Diable Avionics ships, weapons and fighters, access them in the refit screen!

Click on the image to see it in full size.

This mod can be enabled and disabled at any time.


Credits:
Diable Avionics faction: Tartiflette and FlashFrozen
Luxurious Bronze alternative color scheme: Nes

aiDescription: Provides a comprehensive skin pack featuring custom paintjobs for ships, weapons, and fighters. These skins are accessible directly in the refit screen. The pack includes new Virtuous and Gust skins and utilizes the Magic Lib paintjob framework.
